input.title: Product Designer (Remote)
input.descriptionText:
We're Canopy, a climate-data platform helping asset managers measure physical risk.

What you'll do
- Own the end-to-end design of our portfolio analytics experience
- Partner with product managers and engineers to ship weekly
- Run user research with customers across Europe and the Middle East

About you
- 4+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS
- Excellent Figma skills and experience contributing to a design system

This role is remote, EMEA only. We hire through an employer of record across EMEA.
